sections.description: Simple and safe HTML page cache.
sections.changelog:
0.1.20

  • Correct author details in update metadata and declare the translation directory.
  • Retain the admin-menu permission fix from 0.1.19.
0.1.19: Fix a fatal admin-menu error for users without manage_options; preserve administrator menu order and access restrictions. 0.1.18: Send only the required refresh token during revalidation so redundant request headers cannot trigger unrelated no-store responses.
